scope: Executable operator procedures, not an automatic provider runner. No live activation is authorized by this file.

common: Final authoritative state and redacted logs
live: Approved recipient/resource references in private manifest
Provider acceptance and terminal receipt identifiers/timestamps
External state readback for writes; original draft identity/version for updates
Browser evidence for user-visible status; cross-check against owning run

profiles.isolated: Synthetic tenant/project; fault injection only in isolated environment. No production outages or state rewrites.
profiles.jorian: Existing authorized Jorian-only controlled identity. Draft-only email and explicitly confirmed TEST ONLY diary entries. Schedules disabled unless separately reviewed.
profiles.mailboxes: Controlled Outlook and Gmail connections; run each provider separately. Draft-only; no source mailbox mutation.
profiles.workspace: Dedicated granted test documents, Sheets and diary, synthetic data and approved staff identity.
profiles.reception: Controlled phone lines and public/private/disabled projects. Requires separately provisioned and approved second caller/line for unknown-caller variants; do not publish production reception.
profiles.multi-person: Distinct approved primary, fallback and enquirer identities. BLOCKED until provisioned; Jorian alone does not prove multi-person isolation.
profiles.two-tenant: Two deliberately provisioned isolated tenants with admin/operator/restricted users. Never probe unrelated real tenant data.
profiles.email-send: Separate approved sending identity and exact controlled recipient. BLOCKED until approval; never enable sending on draft-only Sharehouse.

variantRules.repeatability: Each variant has its own ledger entry. All required variants/modes must pass; one provider or fixture pass cannot cover another.
